Yes—I can help, but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please tell me the **email address** you used for your order.

Thanks, Mia—I've found your account (**mia_garcia_4516**).

1) The **order id** (e.g., `#W0000000`) for your “recent order”
2) Whether you want to **cancel** (only possible if the order is still **pending**) or **return** (if it’s **delivered**)
3) The **item(s)** you want to keep vs. send back (or at least the items you want to return/cancel)

Once I have the order id, I can check its status and tell you the exact next steps.
I don’t have the order ID handy right now, but I can describe the items I want to return. Is that okay, or do you need the order number to proceed?

To proceed, I **do need the order id** so I can look up the order and confirm its **status** (pending vs delivered) and the exact item ids for what you want to return/cancel.

If you don’t have it handy, tell me **anything you can** (e.g., approximate order date and the items’ names), and I can help you figure out which order it is—but I still need the **order id** to submit a cancellation or a return.

What items are you trying to send back (names and quantities if you can recall), and roughly when did you place the order?

I placed the order about a week ago. I remember there were several items, but I only want to keep the ones that are useful for gaming. The rest I’d like to return or cancel. I think there was a desk lamp, a notebook, and some headphones in the order, along with a couple of other things. 

Could you help me find the order ID based on this info?
